method: Independent leave-one-component-out recompilation with unchanged packing settings. Sprite probes zero bitmap pixels while preserving dimensions and offsets. Code probes remove named bodies/blocks and allow dead-code elimination. Probes are not playable and are never written to dist. Deltas overlap, depend on shared dependencies/compression context, do not sum to file size, and are not guaranteed shippable removal savings.
